name: Do I need to move out during hardwood flooring installation?
description: It's often recommended to vacate the installation area during hardwood flooring work, especially during sanding and finishing, due to dust and fumes.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to move out during hardwood flooring installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: While not always mandatory, it is often recommended to vacate the immediate installation area, or even the home, during hardwood flooring installation, especially during sanding and finishing phases. These stages can generate significant dust and strong fumes from sealants and finishes. Moving out ensures your comfort, minimizes exposure to airborne particles and odors, and allows the installers unobstructed access, which can help streamline the project and ensure optimal cure times for finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: It's often recommended to vacate the installation area during hardwood flooring work, especially during sanding and finishing, due to dust and fumes.
